lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour. Same windows and method as w40b. The w40 m.py was re-run with r40 vs r41 in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/799b632d-abc8-5982-a611-3a2c97f75011/scratchpad/raterB41/, adding c.py (darkest-40 % colour per q15 headrest cover; render y 250-295, photo y 245-280) and d.py (change masks, max channel > 8). q17 is compared on the NEW camera only: r40n (w40 build) vs r41, and r41 vs y_47303. Change fractions: q15 6.3 % (the four headrest covers, the far-row covers and the belt bows), q16 7.9 %, q17 0.9 % (grazing covers barely move, as intended). In the studio: e11 8.5 %, e10 7.7 %, e7 5.2 %, e1 3.6 %, e4 1.3 % and e4b 1.1 %. e5 is bit-identical and every other unit is under 0.3 %.
